**Enum** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public enum Finishing
```

Something a printer does to the printed sheets: staples, holes or a fold.

These are the finishings office printers commonly offer; IPP's others, such as binding or trimming, are set with [PrintOptions.VendorOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#vendoroptions). Values may be added in a later version: treat one you don't know as a finishing the printer may not offer, and a print system refuses one it doesn't know with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception). Positions are as the sheet is read, in its orientation.

## Values

- **`Staple`** (`1`): A staple where the printer chooses.
- **`StapleTopLeft`** (`2`): A staple in the top left corner.
- **`StapleBottomLeft`** (`3`): A staple in the bottom left corner.
- **`StapleTopRight`** (`4`): A staple in the top right corner.
- **`StapleBottomRight`** (`5`): A staple in the bottom right corner.
- **`StapleDualLeft`** (`6`): Two staples along the left edge.
- **`StapleDualTop`** (`7`): Two staples along the top edge.
- **`Punch`** (`8`): Holes punched where the printer chooses.
- **`PunchDualLeft`** (`9`): Two holes along the left edge.
- **`PunchDualTop`** (`10`): Two holes along the top edge.
- **`Fold`** (`11`): A fold where the printer chooses.
